div.head: V Atr 27
div.ab: ⁊ ymbe scipfyrðunga, swa man geornost mæge, þæt æghwylc geset sy sona ofer eastran æghwylce geare.
⁊ ymbe scipfyrðunga, swa man geornost mæge, (gif man þæt geræde) þæt æghwylc geset sy sona ofer eastran æghwylce geare.
⁊ ymbe scipfirðrunga, swa man geornost mæge, þæt æghwilc geset sy sona ofer eastron æghwilce geare.
And the fitting out of ships as diligently as possible, so that in every year they may all be equipped soon after Easter.
Und um Schiffszurüstung, wie man eifrigst vermag (wenn dies verordnet wird G2), dass jedes [Schiff] hergerichtet sei bald nach Ostern in jedem Jahre.
And for the equipping of ships, as eagerly as possible (if that is ordered, G2), so that each [ship] is fitted out soon after Easter every year.
div.note: G2's ‘gif man þæt geræde’ was written above the line in the 12th century.
